import dataclasses
import ipaddress
import unittest

from solution import NodeRecord, create_node


class NodeRecordTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_defaults_and_normalization(self):
        node = create_node("  edge-01  ", "2001:0db8:0:0:0:0:0:1")
        self.assertIsInstance(node, NodeRecord)
        self.assertEqual(node.hostname, "edge-01")
        self.assertEqual(node.address, "2001:db8::1")
        self.assertIsNone(node.purpose)
        self.assertEqual(node.platform, "linux")
        self.assertIsNone(node.cpu_count)
        self.assertIsNone(node.memory)
        self.assertIs(node.active, True)
        self.assertEqual(node.metadata, {})

    def test_all_fields_and_ipv4_canonicalization(self):
        node = create_node("x", "192.168.001.001" if False else "192.168.1.1",
                           purpose="cache", platform="bsd", cpu_count=8,
                           memory="16 GiB", active=False, metadata={"zone": "a"})
        self.assertEqual(node, NodeRecord("x", "192.168.1.1", "cache", "bsd", 8,
                                          "16 GiB", False, {"zone": "a"}))

    def test_frozen_record_but_metadata_is_inspectable(self):
        node = create_node("node", "127.0.0.1", metadata={"roles": ["api"]})
        with self.assertRaises(dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError):
            node.hostname = "other"
        node.metadata["roles"].append("worker")
        self.assertEqual(node.metadata, {"roles": ["api", "worker"]})

    def test_metadata_is_deep_copied(self):
        metadata = {"nested": {"values": [1, 2]}}
        node = create_node("node", "::1", metadata=metadata)
        metadata["nested"]["values"].append(3)
        metadata["new"] = True
        self.assertEqual(node.metadata, {"nested": {"values": [1, 2]}})
        self.assertIsNot(node.metadata, metadata)
        self.assertIsNot(node.metadata["nested"], metadata["nested"])

    def test_hostname_boundaries(self):
        self.assertEqual(create_node("a" * 48, "127.0.0.1").hostname, "a" * 48)
        for hostname in [None, 7, "", "   ", "a" * 49]:
            with self.subTest(hostname=hostname):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    create_node(hostname, "127.0.0.1")

    def test_invalid_addresses(self):
        for address in [None, 123, "", "999.1.1.1", "not-an-ip", "1.2.3"]:
            with self.subTest(address=address):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    create_node("node", address)

    def test_purpose_memory_and_platform_validation(self):
        create_node("node", "127.0.0.1", purpose="p" * 80, memory="m" * 24, platform="other")
        invalid_options = [
            {"purpose": 1}, {"purpose": "p" * 81},
            {"memory": 1}, {"memory": "m" * 25},
            {"platform": "Linux"}, {"platform": "windows"}, {"platform": None},
        ]
        for options in invalid_options:
            with self.subTest(options=options):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    create_node("node", "127.0.0.1", **options)

    def test_cpu_active_and_metadata_validation(self):
        for cpu in [0, -1, True, False, 1.5, "2"]:
            with self.subTest(cpu=cpu):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    create_node("node", "127.0.0.1", cpu_count=cpu)
        for active in [0, 1, None, "yes"]:
            with self.subTest(active=active):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    create_node("node", "127.0.0.1", active=active)
        for metadata in [[], "x", 3]:
            with self.subTest(metadata=metadata):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    create_node("node", "127.0.0.1", metadata=metadata)
        self.assertEqual(create_node("node", "127.0.0.1", cpu_count=1).cpu_count, 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
